hints.title: Inward Boundary Traversal
hints.text: Iterate inward by pairing numbers from the beginning and end of the list until all values are consumed.

hints.title: Concatenation Rule
hints.text: For each pair at left and right indices, append the decimal string of the right value to the left value and convert to integer.

hints.title: Odd Length Center Handling
hints.text: When left index equals right index, append the single remaining number directly to the running sum.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Concatenation Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass two-pointer simulation over the input array.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Modifying or splicing the array directly incurs O(n^2) time due to element shifting.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space using two pointer indices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Traverses the array from both ends without mutating the array.
